messages:
anya: Quick proposal: implement a console-first rollout flow for the new safe_flag that shifts routing weights and changes quota dead-letter behavior. want ops + console pm eyes before i write the RFC.

miguel: sounds useful. how is this different from our current cohort rollouts?

anya: main diffs: preview cost projection per cohort, a dry-run shadow split for behavior verification, and an automated telemetry gate to stop ramps on SLO or quality regressions.

sam: projection needs cheap estimator only. we don't want per-tenant heavy sims. can we use 24h rolling metrics + cache-hit heuristic?

jess: yes, fine as estimate. UI should say "estimated" and show confidence band, not a promise. :warning:

anya: exactly — show 90% CI and a tooltip: "estimated; actuals vary with traffic shape and batch/caching behavior". keep language conservative.

chen: ops Q: for the dead-letter change (dlq-v1 -> dlq-v2), can we shadow that change so production routing stays unchanged but we validate DLQ consumers?

anya: plan: preview -> dry-run (shadow for X% requests) -> canary cohort (1% by default) -> staged ramp. dry-run default 2 hours. shadow includes full headers and tags but response path stays the same.

miguel: do we expose this as console-only or provide an API too? infra will automate.

anya: API-first. console is just a UI on top. example apply PATCH below: 

```
PATCH /v1/runtime-configs/{config_id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "apply_mode": "staged",    // options: immediate|staged|dryrun
  "staged": { "steps": [ { "cohort": "canary-1", "percent": 1, "duration_minutes": 30 }, { "cohort": "canary-2", "percent": 10, "duration_minutes": 60 } ] },
  "changes": { "routing.dead_letter": "dlq-v2", "routing.weights": { "fast": 0.6, "slow": 0.4 } }
}
```

sam: telemetry gate details? what signals and thresholds?

anya: two classes: safety and quality. safety = latency p95, error-rate, quota-failure-rate. quality = eval probes on preset prompt sets + fuzzy-diff of outputs. gate trips if safety delta > 0.5% abs or quality fail rate > configured threshold.

jess: where do probes run? do we show their diffs in preview?

anya: reuse eval service. run small set of probes during dry-run and canary. surface pass/fail + diff histogram in preview and the rollout timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runtime-config service: canary deploy started in staging :rocket:

micah: approval flow: product needs to sign off on quality; platform controls mechanics. need explicit approval step in console before global.

miguel: add auto-approve option if telemetry remains green for N windows. also allow emergency auto-rollback if a critical signal spikes.

chen: escape hatch: for the DLQ switch we need atomic revert of that single path without rolling back other changes. can API support revert_paths?

anya: yes — API supports revert_paths in PATCH so operators can flip only specific fields back atomically. example: { "revert_paths": ["routing.dead_letter"] }.

sam: tracing wise, add rollout_id header so traces/metrics can attribute to rollout stage. makes postmortems much easier.

anya: rollout_id header + telemetry events tagged with rollout_id. also add a rollout field on sample logs.

jess: UI: for tenants with <100 req/day, gray out cost delta and show "insufficient data". don't surface noisy estimates.

miguel: LGTM. next steps: you (anya) draft RFC, i'll own API contract, ops (chen) drafts runbook including dry-run cadence and DLQ consumer validation, console pm will mock approval UX.

anya: thanks — i'll post RFC link here once done. tagging @chen @sam for runbook sync. :eyes:
